boards.school_name: Massachusetts College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences
boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented MCPHS recurring practices, ceremonies, and campus events with official university evidence.

cards.title: Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Boston campus • annual fall tradition
cards.notes: Watch the Campus Life page for registration and event details, then plan a campus visit with family or friends during the October weekend.
cards.short_summary: An annual MCPHS gathering that brings students’ families and friends into campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS identifies Family Weekend as an annual tradition for current students’ family and friends, with on- and off-campus programs.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists October 2–4, 2026; registration details are forthcoming.

cards.title: The Fermented Foods Luncheon
cards.subtitle: Advanced Microbiology • before finals
cards.notes: If enrolled in Advanced Microbiology, ask the instructor about the semester-end luncheon and bring a fermented-food curiosity rather than assumptions.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding class finale built around fermented foods and microbiology.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS describes the Advanced Microbiology Fermented Foods Luncheon as a longstanding class tradition held before finals.
cards.source_title: ‘Nice and Moldy’: Microbiology Students Get a Flavorful Finale | MCPHS News
cards.access_notes: Participation is tied to the Advanced Microbiology course; confirm details with the course instructor.

cards.title: Late Night Breakfast Before Finals
cards.subtitle: Fennell Atrium • Boston campus
cards.notes: Check Campus Life announcements near the end of April and use the gathering as a study break before finals week begins.
cards.short_summary: Faculty and staff serve breakfast foods to students at the start of finals week.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS calls Late Night Breakfast a beloved tradition marking the start of finals week on the Boston campus.
cards.source_title: MCPHS 2025: A Year in Photos | MCPHS News
cards.access_notes: The cited 2025 event occurred at the end of April; confirm the next event’s time and location with Campus Life.

cards.title: Black Excellence Dinner
cards.subtitle: Black Student Union • Black History Month
cards.notes: Look for the Black Student Union’s February announcement, register by its deadline, and join the program celebrating Black excellence in healthcare.
cards.short_summary: A Black History Month dinner connecting MCPHS students, faculty, staff, and alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS reported that its Boston Black Student Union hosted the fourth annual Black Excellence Dinner in February 2025.
cards.source_title: MCPHS 2025: A Year in Photos | MCPHS News
cards.access_notes: The 2025 listing required advance registration and stated that admission was free.

cards.entity_name: School of Pharmacy—Boston Capstone Business Plan Competition
cards.title: The Capstone Business Plan Competition
cards.subtitle: PharmD • School of Pharmacy—Boston
cards.notes: PharmD students can use the year-long capstone to develop a healthcare business concept, then prepare a clear pitch and poster for judges.
cards.short_summary: An annual PharmD competition where teams present healthcare business plans to industry judges.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS reported that 25 PharmD teams took part in the 22nd annual Capstone Business Plan Competition in 2026.
cards.source_title: Whimsy Wins Annual Pharmacy Business Competition | MCPHS News
cards.access_notes: This is part of the School of Pharmacy—Boston PharmD capstone experience; participation depends on program enrollment.

cards.title: The Student Research Conference
cards.subtitle: Boston campus • annual spring showcase
cards.notes: Submit an eligible abstract when the call opens, then practice explaining your research through a poster or oral presentation.
cards.short_summary: A university-wide Boston conference for student posters and presentations across healthcare disciplines.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS held its seventh annual Student Research Conference in Boston in 2026, featuring nearly 200 student presentations.
cards.source_title: From Curiosity to Care: Students Showcase Research with an Eye on Their Futures | MCPHS News
cards.access_notes: The conference is held annually; submission requirements and dates are announced by the Center for Research and Discovery.

cards.title: Harvest Ball
cards.subtitle: Boston campus • annual formal event
cards.notes: Watch Campus Life announcements in fall for tickets, attire guidance, and the event theme before making plans with friends.
cards.short_summary: A large annual MCPHS formal with dinner, music, and dancing.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS describes Harvest Ball as part of its annual formal-event schedule and reported a 2024 Boston gathering with a themed dinner and dancing.
cards.access_notes: Event details, including attendance requirements and any cost, vary by year; consult Campus Life announcements.

cards.title: Cardinal Days in the Atrium
cards.subtitle: Boston campus • monthly campus celebration
cards.notes: Drop by the Atrium when a Cardinal Day is announced to join the activities, meet classmates, and take part in the month’s campus gathering.
cards.short_summary: A monthly Atrium celebration featuring Red the Cardinal, games, refreshments, and MCPHS activities.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS says its Atrium becomes a monthly celebration of MCPHS during Cardinal Days, with Red the Cardinal, games, refreshments, and activities.
cards.access_notes: The university describes these as monthly events; consult Campus Life communications for the next date.

cards.title: The PharmD White Coat Ceremony
cards.subtitle: School of Pharmacy • new-student milestone
cards.notes: New PharmD students should complete the school’s coat-order steps and attend orientation, where the ceremony marks entry into pharmacy study.
cards.short_summary: A formal beginning-of-program milestone for incoming MCPHS PharmD students.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS describes its PharmD White Coat Ceremony as a milestone marking the beginning of students’ pharmacy journey and connection with classmates.
cards.source_title: Next Steps for Enrolled PharmD Students—Worcester | MCPHS
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 ceremony is part of the Worcester/Manchester PharmD orientation; it is a closed event without guests.

cards.title: Nursing’s Pinning Ceremony
cards.subtitle: School of Nursing • professional initiation
cards.notes: Eligible nursing students should follow their program’s graduation communications and choose a pinning participant only when the school provides that option.
cards.short_summary: A nursing-school ceremony recognizing students’ transition into the profession.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS characterizes its nursing pinning ceremony as a time-honored tradition that signifies a student’s official initiation into nursing.
cards.source_title: Manchester Nursing Student Is A ‘Rising Star’ | MCPHS News
cards.access_notes: The cited ceremony was for the Manchester post-baccalaureate nursing cohort; program-specific instructions govern participation.
